source_text:
domain define-product-ontology-readiness "Product Ontology readiness"
profile declarative-function-v1
owner alch-language-product-owner
logic sfol-v1

schema ProductReadinessFacts:
  definition_pack_current: boolean
  product_questions_complete: boolean
  semantic_grounding_pass: boolean
  non_collapse_pass: boolean
  orthogonality_pass: boolean

schema ProductReadinessDecision:
  status: string pattern "^(block|ready)$"
  repair_focus: string pattern "^(definition-pack|product-questions|semantic-grounding|non-collapse|orthogonality|none)$"
  authority_effect: string const "none"

mapping DefinitionPackBlocked:
  target ProductReadinessDecision
  field status = "block"
  field repair_focus = "definition-pack"
  field authority_effect = "none"

mapping ProductQuestionsBlocked:
  target ProductReadinessDecision
  field status = "block"
  field repair_focus = "product-questions"
  field authority_effect = "none"

mapping ProductGroundingBlocked:
  target ProductReadinessDecision
  field status = "block"
  field repair_focus = "semantic-grounding"
  field authority_effect = "none"

mapping ProductNonCollapseBlocked:
  target ProductReadinessDecision
  field status = "block"
  field repair_focus = "non-collapse"
  field authority_effect = "none"

mapping ProductOrthogonalityBlocked:
  target ProductReadinessDecision
  field status = "block"
  field repair_focus = "orthogonality"
  field authority_effect = "none"

mapping ProductOntologyReady:
  target ProductReadinessDecision
  field status = "ready"
  field repair_focus = "none"
  field authority_effect = "none"

rule DefinitionPackMissing:
  condition input.definition_pack_current == false

rule ProductQuestionsIncomplete:
  condition input.definition_pack_current and input.product_questions_complete == false

rule ProductGroundingFailed:
  condition input.definition_pack_current and input.product_questions_complete and input.semantic_grounding_pass == false

rule ProductNonCollapseFailed:
  condition input.definition_pack_current and input.product_questions_complete and input.semantic_grounding_pass and input.non_collapse_pass == false

rule ProductOrthogonalityFailed:
  condition input.definition_pack_current and input.product_questions_complete and input.semantic_grounding_pass and input.non_collapse_pass and input.orthogonality_pass == false

rule ProductCanMaterialize:
  condition input.definition_pack_current and input.product_questions_complete and input.semantic_grounding_pass and input.non_collapse_pass and input.orthogonality_pass

result EvaluateProductOntologyReadiness:
  when DefinitionPackMissing yield DefinitionPackBlocked
  when ProductQuestionsIncomplete yield ProductQuestionsBlocked
  when ProductGroundingFailed yield ProductGroundingBlocked
  when ProductNonCollapseFailed yield ProductNonCollapseBlocked
  when ProductOrthogonalityFailed yield ProductOrthogonalityBlocked
  when ProductCanMaterialize yield ProductOntologyReady

endpoint DefineProductOntologyReadiness:
  target node-http
  runtime node>=26.8.1
  method POST
  path "/define/product-ontology/readiness"
  input ProductReadinessFacts
  output ProductReadinessDecision
  result EvaluateProductOntologyReadiness
  auth-env DEFINE_RUNTIME_TOKEN
  max-bytes 16384
  timeout-ms 1000
  error-status 422
  status block 422
  status ready 200
